about: The oracle rows (tools/oracle.py): each runs on trash-cli and on this repository's tools in matching scratch homes. Paths in make steps are relative to the home, or @xdev/ for the second file system; \\xHH in a path or an argument is one byte. A step may say "tty" (its input a terminal); "dated" and "tree" make steps date an info file from now and generate a tree from a seed; "property": "round-trip" holds the trees outside the trash to what they were before the first command.
